payload.text:
Benchmark B1-clean.
Create file b1_probe.txt with exact logical UTF-8 content:
TASK151A_B1_CLEAN
write=passed
read=passed
verify=passed

The file must end with exactly one terminal newline.
After the write, perform exactly one read_file of b1_probe.txt and exactly one verify_file_content with kind=equals and the full exact content above.
Do not inspect or modify any other user file. Do not use git. Do not add extra READ/VERIFY calls.
Return SUCCESS only if WRITE -> exact READ -> exact EQUALS all succeeded.
